description: Save a new product or service of the connected facturo account, e.g. 'leg das als Produkt an'. name, price and unit are required; ask for what is missing. A product with the same name is returned instead of duplicated; change that one with update_product. The product then shows in list_products and at facturo.at.

description.description: Optional standard specs (dimensions, scope, options). They prefill the item details whenever the product goes onto a line.

name.description: Name as it goes onto the invoice line, one line, e.g. 'Regiestunde' or 'Fliesen verlegen'

price.description: Unit price in EUR as it goes onto the invoice line, e.g. '95', '95.50' or '95,50'

unit.description: Unit the price is for, e.g. 'Std', 'Stk', 'm²', 'pauschal'

vat_rate.description: Optional own VAT rate in percent ('10', '13', '4,9'), only on accounts with per-line VAT rates. Empty string: the product follows the document's rate.

name: create_product
title: Produkt anlegen
